purpose: Mock-only acceptance for Delphi operator invite issue/revoke responses.
coverage: OpenAPI publishes exact strict response schemas for invite creation and revocation
A first invite returns a 64-character one-time token and a pending status; request replay returns null token and HTTP 200
Invite creation binds returned location and study to route path parameters
Revocation requires the fixed revoked status and binds the returned invite ID to the path
Malformed, extra, and mismatched service output returns a sanitized no-store 503 without token leakage

environment.fixtures: Synthetic service dictionaries and in-process FastAPI TestClient.
